basis: The dashboard shows the May 06 Station X (blue) segment as a very thin sliver at the bottom of the stacked bar, starting at the 1,500 baseline. In contrast, the Station Y (green) and Station Z (orange) segments are significantly taller, and the May 06 total is the highest on the chart (~5,300). While no explicit numeric threshold is printed, the visual evidence indicates Station X has minimal demand relative to the other stations and the total load, which supports routing to a low-demand response rather than normal monitoring or high-demand crowding response.
